reason: Verified per-site (RFC 0106): `options.except(:name, :algorithm).empty?` (schema_statements.rb:1830) — `empty?` on a Ruby Hash, whose faithful JS spelling is `Object.keys(h).length === 0`. That emits no callee, so no TS call can ever credit the Ruby one. The gate flags it only because `empty?` maps onto the unrelated `ActiveRecord::Result.empty`, which takes arguments since it gained Rails' `async:` kwarg (result.rb:94-100) — nothing in the TS body was dropped.
